text:
Maria G.: heads up — I'm opening a single 'error reference catalog' doc to consolidate 429s, timeouts, context-limit guidance and fallback examples. want this to be the canonical troubleshooting page we can link from SDKs and runbooks.
Kevin L.: love it. do you want separate sections for client-side vs server-side handling?
Maria G.: yes. plan: quick summary table, then sections: 429 handling, request timeouts, context/window limits, graceful degradation & fallback strategies, and SDK snippet gallery.
Ashley R.: can we include an explicit migration subsection for old SDKs that used `retry_policy: aggressive`? we've had customers hit regressions.
Maria G.: good point — will add a migration subsection with example diffs.
Docs Bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/3921 — draft branch error-ref-catalog.
Samir P.: reviewing now. first pass: the 429 section needs clearer prioritized actions — short-term (client backoff), mid (circuit breaker), long (route to cheaper model).
Maria G.: agreed. draft has a small flowchart but i'll expand into an action list.
Kevin L.: for SDK snippets, can we do a minimal JS + Python example showing exponential backoff + jitter + fallback to streaming lighter model? small, copy-pasteable.
Maria G.: yep — i'll add these. example plan: JS axios retry wrapper; Python requests + tenacity snippet; and a Node SDK example using our official client with context trimming helper.
Ashley R.: also flag common gotchas: trimming middle vs prefix, preserving function call tokens, and rapid-fallback causing duplicate requests.
Maria G.: noted. i'll add an explicit 'do not' list and emphasize best-effort ordering for trimming.
Samir P.: link fixes: there's an old link to the rate-limit explainer in /guides that 404s. update to /ops/rate-limits-101. i'll paste the exact url in comments.
Maria G.: thanks, paste it here when you have it.
Docs Bot: CI: spellcheck passed, link-checker found 1 broken link (line 112).
Kevin L.: i can take link fix + small wording tweaks. assign to me?
Maria G.: assigning Kevin. also need a quick accuracy pass from runtime team on the 'automatic fallback to quantized model' text — might be oversimplified.
Samir P.: i'll ping eng-runtime. we shouldn't promise automatic fallbacks unless config opts in.
Maria G.: ok — i'll reword to 'can be configured to fallback'.
Ashley R.: for the examples, can we add a small test harness (curl + expected status codes) that people can run locally to reproduce 429 vs 504 behavior? helps support reproduce issues.
Maria G.: great idea — i'll add a folder with reproducible cURL commands and a tiny node script that simulates high QPS against a mock endpoint.
Kevin L.: on the migration subsection: include a before/after config snippet for the SDK where we recommend `max_concurrent_requests` and `batching` changes. customers keep forgetting those.
Maria G.: will include. also adding a 'when to contact support' callout with required info (request IDs, route, tokens, sample prompts).
Samir P.: thumbs up. once eng-runtime reviews the fallback wording we can move from draft to ready-for-review. timeline?
Maria G.: aiming EOD tomorrow for a review-ready PR. tagging @Kevin and @Samir for final review.
Docs Bot: PR comment added: please add tests for the snippet gallery.
Kevin L.: i'll add a tiny unit test for the Node snippet.
Ashley R.: i'll prepare the migration checklist for release notes.
Maria G.: thanks everyone — i'll push the updates tonight and post again when it's ready for review. :thumbsup:
